titre.en: 10/10 winter hobbies that actually work if you have adhd

notes: Full test (pas de post source) : « 10/10 winter hobbies that actually work if you have adhd », une accroche jamais faite chez nous, au format « 10/10 … if you have adhd » de @traceygreen589 (sa famille à 705 k, 532 k, 169 k). Slide Atala sur une photo de course de la banque (231396d9), slide Artura sur un tableau ou un musée de la banque (a159f9ee), cta B pour les deux. Les autres loisirs en Seedream.

en.titre:
10/10 winter hobbies that
actually work if you have adhd

colonne: balance needs all of your attention, and every lap you stay up is a small _win_ for your brain
en.chute: most rinks rent skates by the hour

en.accroche: your hands are busy, so your _mind slows down_
colonne: the stitches repeat, the scarf grows a little every night, and you can _see_ the progress
en.chute: one ball of chunky wool and big needles to start

en.nom: a museum on a cold day
colonne: winter is the best time to wander a gallery slowly and stop wherever something catches your eye
_pro tip_: artura gives me one painting a day and the story behind it, in a few minutes
en.chute: pick one room and stay until you're bored

colonne: your eyes keep scanning for one shape or color, so a scattered brain locks onto _one job_

en.accroche: the cold air _wakes up_ your _whole brain_
colonne: a short run on a grey day burns off restless energy and gives your week a _goal_ to chase
_pro tip_: atala builds my runs around my goal and adjusts them every week
en.chute: wear layers and go at lunch when it's light
